name: ACWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands three times in 1999, from a returning former champion through a masked impostor's own reveal to a son's own change of heart.

name: ACWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by two singles stars calling themselves Love Muscle, ending a four-month reign by the Alliance of Violence.

name: ACWA Television Championship
epitaph: Awarded to the winner of an eight-man tournament final at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.
